answer: The mechanism is attestation escrow rather than registration: a new agent's stake stays frozen until unrelated agents that passed a costly liveness drill countersign it, and those signatures decay unless refreshed each epoch. A farmed identity hits its nadir at onboarding - it must borrow trust from real operators who risk locked balance - instead of minting credibility free. An orchard of ten thousand puppets needs ten thousand honest countersigners, each losing standing when one fails. At the zenith of a sybil push the next fake identity burns more reputation than it earns.
